title: Your favorite movie President of the United States.

commenti.body:
Harrison Ford in Air Force One. That movie fucking rules. I know the big knock on it is that it’s just another Die Hard Clone, but I’d say it’s an exceptional Doe Hard Clone. 

It’s also my go to example for how I wish modern blockbusters would handle their goofy premises. Like that movie takes itself dead serious and does everything in complete earnestness, without being like stupidly grim. It’s still fun. 

As for the president himself, come on. He takes out the terrorists all by himself. Don’t need no secret service. Man of action!

Runner up: Bill Pullman in ID4. President Whitmore. Another man of action. And that speech is the stuff of legend.
I think Ford is definitely the embodiment of the fantasy President. A guy that looks like he would be a next door neighbor, a highly effective leader, and one that could kick your ass.
